<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>UNKNOWN</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
body{min-height:100vh;background:#080808;color:white;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-3;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 20%,#222 0%,transparent 35%),#080808}
.fundo1{position:fixed;z-index:-2;width:80vw;height:260px;top:92px;left:20%;background:#181818;transform:skewY(-4deg)}
.fundo2{position:fixed;z-index:-2;width:110vw;height:300px;top:205px;left:-12%;background:#111;transform:skewY(-3deg)}
.container{width:min(668px,calc(100% - 28px));margin:92px auto 35px}
.perfil{height:260px;background:#191919;text-align:center;position:relative;padding-top:124px}
.foto{position:absolute;width:148px;height:148px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;left:50%;top:-44px;transform:translateX(-50%)}
.nome{font-size:22px;font-weight:800}
.local{color:#aaa;font-size:12px;margin-top:9px}
.bio{font-size:11px;margin-top:10px}
.links{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:15px 20px;margin-top:36px}
.card{height:60px;background:#191919;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:5px 12px 5px 9px;color:white;text-decoration:none;transition:.2s}
.card:first-child{grid-column:1 / -1}
.card:hover{background:#222;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.icone{width:50px;height:50px;flex:0 0 50px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;margin-right:12px;overflow:hidden}.icone img{width:27px;height:27px;object-fit:contain}.roblox img{width:25px;height:25px}.instagram img{width:28px;height:28px}
.discord{background:#5865f2}.roblox{background:#111}.youtube{background:#f21b16}.tiktok{background:#050505}
.conteudo{flex:1;min-width:0}.titulo{font-size:12px;font-weight:bold}.url{color:#777;font-size:10px;margin-top:5px}.seta{color:#aaa;font-size:16px}
@media(max-width:620px){.links{grid-template-columns:1fr}.card:first-child{grid-column:auto}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="fundo1"></div><div class="fundo2"></div>
<div class="container">
<section class="perfil">
<img class="foto" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Foto de perfil">
<h1 class="nome">UNKNOWN</h1>
<div class="local">⌖ Júpiter</div>
<div class="bio">eu amo chocolate 🍫❤️</div>
</section>
<section class="links">
<a class="card" href="https://discord.gg/97ExjQJfV" target="_blank"><div class="icone discord"><img src="https://cdn.simpleicons.org/discord/ffffff" alt="Discord"></div><div class="conteudo"><div class="titulo">Entre pra #111</div><div class="url">discord.gg/97ExjQJfV</div></div><div class="seta">→</div></a>
<a class="card" href="https://www.roblox.com/pt/users/9592275980/profile" target="_blank"><div class="icone roblox"><img src="https://cdn.simpleicons.org/roblox/ffffff" alt="Roblox"></div><div class="conteudo"><div class="titulo">MEU PERFIL NO ROBLOX</div><div class="url">roblox.com/pt/users/9592275980/profile</div></div><div class="seta">→</div></a>
<a class="card" href="https://www.youtube.com/@unknownsfff" target="_blank"><div class="icone youtube"><img src="https://cdn.simpleicons.org/youtube/ffffff" alt="YouTube"></div><div class="conteudo"><div class="titulo">YOUTUBE</div><div class="url">youtube.com/@unknownsfff</div></div><div class="seta">→</div></a>
<a class="card" href="https://www.tiktok.com/@gzmuller" target="_blank"><div class="icone tiktok"><img src="https://cdn.simpleicons.org/tiktok/ffffff" alt="TikTok"></div><div class="conteudo"><div class="titulo">TIKTOK</div><div class="url">tiktok.com/@gzmuller</div></div><div class="seta">→</div></a>

</section></div>
</body>
</html>
